EAM Jaishankar begins two-day visit to Bhutan

External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar began a two-day visit to Bhutan on September 16. During the visit, he is scheduled to hold bilateral talks with Bhutanese Foreign Minister D.N. Dhungyel. Jaishankar will also have a royal audience with King Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck and meet Prime Minister Tshering Tobgay. The Ministry of External Affairs announced the visit's agenda in a press statement.
